caption: Hoge Molen, Nieuw-Lekkerland
composition: Two thatched octagonal mills beside a narrow canal · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: De Hoge Molen at Nieuw-Lekkerland is a thatched octagonal wooden drainage mill on a brick base, with its sails at rest beside a narrow boezem. A second thatched mill stands further along the same bank. The sky is overcast, about 14.6°C, with wind near 6.8 km/h. These are not the round brick towers of the Nederwaard row at Kinderdijk.
